title: Abaarot tan Gaba
intro: Atu dumaahi Makkah addal tan gicloh addat, rooci kee gadda inki adda nummah seecoh addat culteh sugte. ta muucih aydaadi qabli fantaaxaw kaxxiini silsilatak yayseenim maduudan qaduk kassiisi. iyyaay iyyaay kay migaq qammaltah tan girat qagaaqagitak?
clues: Anu farmoyti yi qabalak sugem takkay immay, nummat yoo inti maleelah tan kaxxiina luk Makkah gitittet gexe.
Yi ikoyta baar luk sugte, takkay immay oson goobuk muxxi abaaro yekken.
miracsenta kitab yi finqat yaaba, yi gaba kee yi num finqitelem yaybeleeleqeh.
Yi barra yi qaduwwih gaatut tengele, Yalla seeca numih gital fixiixisuh quuek gaaboysak.
cokmi ayro, anu girah addat culeyyo, kee yi barra filla dariifal palm fiber akatta le.
Anu 'father of flame' yaanam migaq luk aaxaguk suge — migaq yi amotani giclo wagsiisak.
